cases.case_label: Full-length L1HS deep in DMD intron 51, partial exonization
cases.mechanism_detail: A ~6 kb full-length L1HS deep in intron 51 activates a cryptic acceptor in intron 51 and a cryptic donor inside the L1, so a 103-nt pseudo-exon (5 nt intronic + 98 nt L1) is spliced between exons 51 and 52 (r.7542_7543ins(103)), shifting the frame (p.Ala2515Asnfs*21); residual wild-type transcript explains the milder BMD phenotype.
cases.quote: This corresponded to the partial exonization of a long interspersed nuclear element (LINE-1), disrupting the open reading frame.
